P3_TEXT: On April 27, 2011 Navy Marine Coast Guard Residence Foundation, Inc. merged into Navy Marine Coast Guard Residence Foundation (formerly NMCGR Foundation) (EIN # 27-3032859), with Navy Marine Coast Guard Residence Foundation surviving and Navy Marine Coast Guard Residence Foundation, Inc. ceasing to exist (the "Merger"). Navy Marine Coast Guard Residence Foundation was formed on June 8, 2010 and received a determination letter from the IRS on April 13, 2011 stating that it had determined that Navy Marine Coast Guard Residence Foundation was exempt from federal income tax under section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code. Prior to the Merger, Navy Marine Coast Guard Residence Foundation did not undertake any trade or business activities. Navy Marine Coast Guard Residence Foundation's sole purpose in being formed was to be the surviving entity in the Merger with Navy Marine Coast Guard Residence Foundation Inc. and to continue, wholesale, the business operations of Navy Marine Coast Guard Residence Foundation, Inc. As a result of the Merger, for federal income tax purposes, all of the liabilities (including tax-exempt bond liabilities) and assets of Navy Marine Cost Guard Residence Foundation, Inc. were transferred to Navy Marine Coast Guard Residence Foundation. In addition, all of the officers, directors, and employees of Navy Marine Coast Guard Residence Foundation, Inc. were officers, directors, and employees of Navy Marine Coast Guard Residence Foundation subsequent to the Merger.
